user.title: Set up seenzus MQTT Bridge
user.description: Choose a pairing mode to open its setup form.

seamless.title: Quick pair
seamless.description: The integration creates a web pairing session through the seenzus API and opens seenzus for authorization. Select Submit to continue; no fields are required.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter the manual pairing settings. MQTT connection settings and advanced settings are collapsed by default.

mqtt_settings.name: MQTT connection settings
mqtt_settings.description: Remote brokers require MQTT over TLS or secure WebSocket. Plaintext connections are allowed only for explicit local or loopback IP addresses.

data_description.mqtt_port: Leave blank to use the standard port for the selected protocol: mqtts 8883, wss 443, mqtt 1883, or ws 80. Enter custom ports explicitly.
data_description.mqtt_ws_path: Secure WebSocket commonly uses /mqtt. Use the path configured on your broker.

advanced_settings.name: Advanced settings
advanced_settings.description: Collapsed by default. Change these only to customize protocol settings or state event publishing.

data.bridge_id: Bridge ID (leave blank to generate automatically)
data.allow_dangerous_services: Allow dangerous services (hassio, shell_command, python_script, etc.; off by default)
data.enable_template_api: Allow the /api/template rendering API (off by default)
data.expose_full_config: Expose full /api/config, including home coordinates (off by default)

data_description.mqtt_max_packet_size_kib: Local sending limit; must not exceed the broker's packet size limit. 1024 KiB = 1 MiB; 2048 KiB = 2 MiB. This does not change the broker configuration.

error.dev_override_invalid: The developer override file seenzus_bridge_dev.json is invalid: its JSON is malformed or pairing_api_base is not a valid HTTP(S) URL. Correct or remove the file and try again.
error.quick_pair_session_failed: Could not create a quick pairing session. Check the seenzus API address, DNS, and service status.
error.quick_pair_bootstrap_failed: Could not read the final web pairing status. Confirm that pairing was completed on the web page.
error.quick_pair_mqtt_missing: The backend did not return MQTT bridge settings. Quick pairing cannot finish.
error.quick_pair_callback_unavailable: Could not generate the Home Assistant callback URL. Check the current address or the instance URL settings.
error.quick_pair_authorization_failed: External authorization did not finish. Start quick pairing again.
error.quick_pair_callback_state_mismatch: Callback state validation failed. Start quick pairing again.
error.quick_pair_code_exchange_failed: The callback succeeded, but exchanging the code for bridge settings failed. Check the backend service status.
error.quick_pair_callback_timeout: No callback confirmation was received. Complete authorization on the external page and return to Home Assistant.
error.quick_pair_missing_context: The quick pairing session was lost. Start again.
error.invalid_mqtt_packet_size: Enter an integer from 1 to 262144 (KiB) that does not exceed the broker's packet size limit.
error.mqtt_packet_size_too_small_for_topic: This limit cannot fit the minimum offline message for the current topic. Increase the limit or shorten the topic or Bridge ID.
error.mqtt_transport_required: The MQTT transport protocol is missing or invalid. Select mqtts/wss. For quick pairing, have the backend supply a valid protocol and pair again. Plaintext fallback is not allowed.
error.mqtt_tls_required: This broker requires TLS (mqtts or wss). Plaintext MQTT/WebSocket is allowed only for explicit local or loopback IP addresses. Check the protocol and port.

abort.already_configured: seenzus MQTT Bridge is already configured. Only one instance is supported.
abort.quick_pair_missing_context: The quick pairing session was lost. Start again.

init.title: Configure seenzus MQTT Bridge
init.description: Change MQTT connection settings or pair again. Saving settings automatically reloads the integration.

seamless.description: Start external seenzus quick pairing again. Select Submit; no fields are required. The integration creates a web pairing session through the seenzus API. After authorization, the browser returns to Home Assistant and the MQTT bridge settings are updated automatically.
